title: The 8 Best Scroll Saws 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for scroll saws 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at scroll saws 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT DW788 20-Inch Variable Speed Scroll Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 20-inch throat depth, 400-1,750 SPM variable speed, Parallel link arm design for low vibration.
strengths: Parallel link arm design reduces vibration dramatically compared to single-arm saws
400 to 1,750 SPM range covers all materials from hardwood to thin acrylic
20-inch throat gives the maximum working room in the benchtop category
Tool-free blade change is the standard most scroll saw users expect
limitations: Higher price than most competitor scroll saws
No dust blower in the base model
features: Parallel link arm design for low vibration
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: WEN 3921 16-inch Two-Direction Variable Speed Scroll Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 16-inch throat, 400-1,600 SPM variable speed, Accepts pin-end and pinless blades.
strengths: Lowest price in the variable-speed scroll saw category from a reputable brand
Accepts both pin-end and pinless blades, giving access to the full blade selection
Variable speed from 400 SPM enables control in delicate fretwork
Includes dust port for shop vacuum connection
limitations: More vibration than the DEWALT parallel arm design
16-inch throat limits working size compared to 20-inch saws
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Excalibur EX-21 21-Inch Tilting Head Scroll Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 21-inch throat depth, Tilting head design for angled cuts without tilting the table, Foot switch controller included.
strengths: Virtually vibration-free operation -- Excalibur is a scroll saw benchmark for precision work
Tilting head lets the blade angle while the workpiece stays flat on the table
21-inch throat is among the largest available in a consumer scroll saw
Foot switch controller keeps both hands free to guide the workpiece
limitations: Very high price -- difficult to justify for casual hobbyists
Sold mostly through specialty woodworking dealers, not big-box retail
features: Tilting head design for angled cuts without tilting the table
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Dremel MS20-01 Moto-Saw Variable Speed Compact Scroll Saw Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: Benchtop or handheld use, 6-inch throat, Uses standard scroll saw blades.
strengths: Smallest footprint of any scroll saw -- works on a small desk or workbench
Can be used freehand when detached from the base
Uses standard scroll saw blades available everywhere
Lowest price in the scroll saw category
limitations: 6-inch throat limits working size to small projects
Not a substitute for a full scroll saw -- for very small craft work only

products.name: Rikon 10-600VS 16-inch Scroll Saw with Lamp
products.blurb: Key specs: 16-inch throat, 400-1,750 SPM variable speed, Parallel link design.
strengths: Parallel link design at a lower price than DEWALT
Same 1,750 SPM max speed as the DEWALT DW788
Tool-free blade change system
RIKON customer service and parts availability are better than offshore brands
limitations: 16-inch throat vs 20-inch on the DEWALT -- smaller maximum project size
Slightly more vibration than the DW788 in direct comparison

products.name: Shop Fox W1713 16-Inch Variable Speed Scroll Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: Built-in work light, Dust blower, 16-inch throat.
strengths: Built-in work light illuminates the cut line without a separate lamp
Dust blower keeps the cut line clear -- critical for pattern-following accuracy
Both work light and blower are included vs optional on competing saws
Solid table and fence for straight cuts
limitations: Less refined arm geometry than RIKON or DEWALT
Variable speed range starts at 500 SPM vs 400 on competitors

products.name: SKIL 1.2 Amp 16 in. Variable Speed Scroll Saw with LED Work Light
products.blurb: Key specs: 16-inch throat, Variable speed, LED work light.
strengths: SKIL parts and service network provides accessible support for hobbyists
LED work light illuminates the cut line without a separate lamp
Good balance of features for a first scroll saw purchase
Widely available at big-box retail -- easy to inspect before buying
limitations: Build quality below the RIKON and DEWALT at a similar price

products.name: JET JWSS-18B 18-Inch Variable-Speed Scroll Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 18-inch throat depth, Variable speed control, Tilting table for angled cuts.
strengths: 18-inch throat -- larger than most mid-range saws -- handles bigger workpieces
Cast iron table provides a stable, accurate surface for angle cuts
JET build quality and parts availability through a national service network
Tilting table accommodates bevel cuts without repositioning the workpiece
